notes:
The build that updates itself.

- The app checks for a new build, downloads it in the background, verifies it,
  and installs it when you quit. Nothing is replaced while you are working.
- Every update is signed. A version file not signed by NeXGen is refused, so
  getting into the releases repository is not enough to push anything.
- A real plan set opens in under a second. An 84.6 MB, 62-sheet construction
  set used to take eight seconds to show its first sheet, and locked up when
  you zoomed in.
- The estimate opens instantly on a big job — 4,000 marks went from 29 seconds
  to under one.
- Revisions: price the design development set, price the construction documents
  when they land, and see exactly what moved, group by group.
- Click any figure in the Cost column to see the marks behind it on the sheet.
- 1–9 and the bracket keys switch which group you are measuring into.
- Cost codes carry through to invoices and purchase orders.
- Photos taken on an iPhone no longer arrive as broken images.
